scripts.build: bun run gen:version && bun run gen:icons && vite build
scripts.build:binary: bun run build && bun run embed && bun build src/backend/server.js --compile --outfile chops
scripts.build:binary:linux: bun run build && bun run embed && bun build src/backend/server.js --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile chops-linux-x64
scripts.build:binary:mac: bun run build && bun run embed && bun build src/backend/server.js --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile chops-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:binary:windows: bun run build && bun run embed && bun build src/backend/server.js --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile chops-windows-x64.exe
scripts.build:standalone:mac: bun run build && bun run embed && bun build src/backend/server.js --compile --env=inline --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile chops-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:standalone:linux: bun run build && bun run embed && bun build src/backend/server.js --compile --env=inline --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile chops-linux-x64
scripts.build:standalone:windows: bun run build && bun run embed && bun build src/backend/server.js --compile --env=inline --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile chops-windows-x64.exe
scripts.test: bun run test:backend && vitest run tests/frontend
scripts.test:backend: bun test --isolate tests/backend && bun test --isolate tests/isolated && bun test tests/db && bun test tests/net
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:backend:coverage && bun run test:frontend:coverage
scripts.test:backend:coverage: bun test --isolate tests/backend && bun test tests/db && bun test tests/net
